scoring_justification: T1 recompute of J from the baseline curve is infeasible without the material’s E, so the main J values are scored by result-level comparison (threshold_or_better) against the paper’s reported gold, while the baseline curve is verified structurally (monotonicity, shape).

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold J values for the three target conditions
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 3 (pure PMMA 0.0032, CNT 5wt% 0.0068) and Fig. 10 / Section 4.2 (CNT 10wt% with 2% 2CH₂ crosslinks 0.0110)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction from the source paper’s published numeric results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are verbatim from the paper; they are the same quantities the task asks to reproduce.

outputs.description: Raw potential energy vs. displacement data for baseline CNT 5 wt% without cross-links. The verifier performs a structural audit (required columns, monotonicity) to ensure the file is a valid load-displacement curve; it does not recompute the J-integral from this file.
Agent-reported J-integral values for three conditions. The checker compares these to hidden paper-reported reference values; meeting or beating the reference earns full credit.

output_contract.notes: The baseline load-displacement curve is verified by structural audit; the results.csv J-integral values are compared to gold references under a threshold_or_better policy. There is no cross-validation between the two files.

steps.description: Compare each reported J value to its hidden paper gold. Full credit for meeting or exceeding the gold; partial credit for lower values.
Verify that the submitted CSV contains the required columns, values are numeric, displacement is monotonically increasing, and potential energy is monotonically increasing.
